global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, dark broth with tender noodles, topped with nori seaweed shaped like a cat and sliced menma bamboo shoots. The colorful bowl rests on a tray, illuminated by warm, natural light.

regions.background: Light brown wooden table with smooth, slightly reflective surface and subtle grain patterns visible.
regions.bowl: The ceramic ramen bowl has a cream base, colorful abstract patterns, and a smooth, slightly glossy rim.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, green onions, and mushrooms, rich brown liquid with visible strands and toppings.
regions.seaweed: Dark green nori seaweed sheet, rectangular with white cat face design and "ASAHIBAYAMA Zoo" text printed on its surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale brown, slightly translucent, curved pieces with visible fibrous texture and subtle surface sheen.
